title: Allowable Rent Increases
requirement: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage. Landlords are prohibited from including an additional percentage increase for utilities.
coverage_conditions: rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF). Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.

title: Legal Reasons for Eviction
requirement: All notices to terminate a tenancy for rental units subject to the RSO must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department within three business days of service on the tenant.
coverage_conditions: rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
quoted_span: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.

title: Systematic Code Enforcement Fee
requirement: A landlord may collect 1/12 of 50% of the annual Systematic Code Enforcement Fee from the tenant of the rental unit per month.
coverage_conditions: rental units subject to the RSO
quoted_span: Effective January 1, 2022, a landlord may collect 1/12 of 50% of the annual Systematic Code Enforcement Fee from the tenant of the rental unit per month.
